general_schema.bilingual_fallback: Leave text fields blank to use the built-in English/Arabic copy. Anything you type here overrides it (translate it with Translate & Adapt).
general_schema.heading: Heading

announcement.fallback_info: With no messages added, shows “Climate-adapted skincare · Made in Egypt” in the visitor’s language.
announcement.name: Announcement bar

faq.name: FAQ
faq.question: Question
faq.steps_info: Comma list: 1–4 for the steps, 0 for sets. Leave empty to show everywhere.

forecast.data_info: “Why today” lines come from product metafields bts.forecast_sun / _city / _humidity / _ac / _heat, falling back to bts.benefit.
forecast.name: Skin forecast

glossary.name: Ingredient glossary
glossary.reference: Show as a collapsed reference list (no key-ingredient cards)

header.menu_info: Leave empty to use the built-in bilingual navigation (Shop, Routines, Ingredients, Climate, Journal).
header.name: Header

hero.collection_info: Products appear in routine order (01–04). Defaults to all products.
hero.name: Hero · The space between

ingredients.info: Content comes from the “BTS ingredient” metaobject (name, INCI, role, products).
ingredients.name: Ingredient spotlight

routine.name: Routine grid
routine.show_bundle_info: Adds every product in one tap. The price shown is the plain sum (no invented discount).

story.name: Story rows
story.visual_info: Automatic uses the real packshots where the story is about a product.

ticker.items_info: Separate items with |. Leave blank for the built-in bilingual forecast notation.
ticker.name: Forecast ticker

product_label.name: Product label
product_label.show_info: Shows the printed label for the product's routine step. Turn off if the artwork doesn't match the pack being sold.

bundles.name: Bundles (sets)
bundles.info: Pick Shopify bundle products. Price, struck-through singles total and saving come from the product.
bundles.hide_head: Hide heading (when the page title already says it)

climate_switch.name: Climate switch
climate_switch.photo_prefix_info: Scenes load from Files by name: prefix + condition + -wide.jpg / -tall.jpg. Leave empty for bts-climate-.

creator_apply.name: Creator application
creator_apply.info: Applications arrive in the store’s contact email (Settings → Notifications → Staff notifications → Contact customer). Nothing is stored on the site.

bundle_inside.name: Set: what's inside
bundle_inside.info: Shows on set (bundle) pages only. Built from the set definition and the products' own data and prices.

climate_story.name: Climate: a day story
climate_story.info: Five hours of an Egyptian day. Photos come from Files named bts-climate-[condition]-wide.jpg and -tall.jpg; replace a file keeping its name to change a scene.

ingredient_benefits.name: Ingredients: benefits
ingredient_benefits.info: One chapter per product, from its benefit line and key ingredients.

bundles_feature.name: Sets: pick and companion
bundles_feature.mate_image_info: Optional. Replaces the companion's pack cut-outs.

brand.logo_note: The logo is the exact supplied Between Two Suns vector (assets/bts-wordmark.svg). Replace that file only with a new approved master.
brand.name: Name

colors.name: Name
colors.sku_note: Each routine step has one colour. Colours follow the product (step 01–04 tag or bts.step metafield), never decoration.

commerce.cod_info: Turn on only once Cash on Delivery is configured as a payment method.
commerce.factual_info: Only add statements that are true and configured.
commerce.name: Name
commerce.payment_icons_info: Shows only the payment methods actually enabled in Shopify.
commerce.routine_collection_info: Used for “Complete your routine” in the cart. Defaults to all products.
commerce.shipping_note_info: Optional factual shipping line, e.g. delivery areas. Leave blank to show “Shipping calculated at checkout”.
commerce.zero_price_info: Pre-launch safety: products priced at 0.00 show “Price coming soon” and cannot be added to the bag.

motion.name: Name
motion.signature_info: Scroll-linked hero motion. Always disabled for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

offers.name: Offers & bundles
offers.intro: Savings shown on the site must match real Shopify discounts. Create an automatic discount (Discounts → Amount off products, minimum quantity of items) for each tier you turn on, with the same percentage. Leave at 0 to show no savings.
offers.free_shipping_info: Must match your free-shipping rate in Shopify settings. Empty or 0 hides the progress bar.
offers.whatsapp_info: International format without + or spaces, e.g. 201001234567. Empty hides the chat button.
offers.delivery_fee: Standard delivery fee below the threshold (EGP)
offers.delivery_fee_info: Must match your Shopify shipping rate. Used only for upgrade messages in the bag (e.g. "for EGP 400 more and get free delivery"). 0 hides them.
offers.welcome_info: Shown once per visitor. After sign-up it reveals the code below. The code, amount and minimum must match a real discount in Shopify → Discounts.
